content: ElevenLabs TTS pitfalls: per-request 5000 char limit on paid plans (2500 free), overage charges at 0.30/1k chars beyond quota, WebSocket auto-close after 20s inactivity, auto_mode must be enabled or model stalls waiting for chunk schedule, Flash v2.5 has 75ms inference but real-world TTFB is 400-600ms from distant regions, voice selection impacts latency (default/synthetic fastest, PVC slowest), 429/5xx errors need exponential backoff with jitter.
